benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Eased to about $108.14 on 19 Oct (Trading Economics), down roughly 1.6% on the day, as Iran reiterated its offer to reopen the strait within seven days and Turkey said it will take some diesel under the Russia-US supply deal. Week-ago is this site's 12 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier.
